town.label: Special Return To Black Swan Castle

description: Uneven slabs of dirt and ice float precariously down a twisting, crescent-shaped river of lava.  The chunks of rock remain intact, merely blackened as flames and fire lick their edges, but the slabs of ice form fast and evaporate just as quickly, releasing a torrent of steam and smoke in their hastened demise.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23282.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground rises in a sharp ascent as layers of mud and rock continuously shift upward, twisting and narrowing to form a wide-mouthed clay funnel.  From the brim of the ever-expanding cone spews forth blasts of fiery red lava, which spills down over the edges and pollutes the sky with heavy black clouds of smoke.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23283.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Giant swathes of serrated rock roll across the landscape like the waves of a tumultuous ocean, ascending high and then cascading down in a constant ripple of instability.  The sky itself is filled with nebulous pale green clouds, each one illuminated by spheres of cracking yellow energy within.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23284.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fiery red-gold glaze is masterfully painted across the sky, the unnatural incarnadine clouds floating overhead looking like sinew and blood.  Spindles of fire twist and churn, spiraling down to burn across the ground, leaving long and winding tracks of scorch marks.  An amber haze drifts through the area, scattered to and fro by warm winds.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23285.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground is as black as obsidian, scorched and hardened over countless ages of intense heat.  A shimmering bend in the air stretches across the sky a few hundred feet off the ground, where smooth, thin plates of ice float along the horizon like slender frozen clouds.  Thin wisps of steam rise and fall along the edges of the flickering curve in the air.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23286.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge earthen monolith rises in the distance, jutting up from the ground to form a jagged cone of rock.  From the mountain's edges, huge boulders constantly tumble, slowly forming piles of scattered stones before they are swallowed up by fissures forming periodically along the ground.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23287.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Great nebulous clouds encompass the sky, each one's billowing black surface charged with dozens of arcing bolts of bluish-white lightning.  Enormous pieces of frozen rock fall from within the murky depths of the clouds, each time sending a shockwave of tremors along the ground upon impact.   Vein-like streams of water curve along the patchy ground, winding off into the distance.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23288.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sky is a kaleidoscope of dark copper and bronze hues as a colossal fissure of fire churns among blackened clouds like a giant maw filled with flames.  Globules of lava descend from the red maelstrom, scorching the ground upon impact and smothering the landscape in coils of incandescent vapors.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23289.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The air is thick with soot and ash and the sky is nearly as black as a starless night, only periodically broken up by flashes of crimson fire streaking above.  Rocks can be heard colliding and breaking apart in the distance and tremors rumble faintly underfoot.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23290.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reddish orange flames dot the horizon like a writhing fall of fire, a stark contrast to the huge ice-covered mountain that dominates a majority of the area here.  A bone-chilling wind rushes across the landscape, tossing loose pebbles about as it swirls past.  Occasionally, mammoth icicles break off from ridges along the arctic mountain, crashing and shattering on the ground below.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23291.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A giant lake opens up in the center of the area, one side of it being fed by streams of water flowing down from a cavernous mountain while the other side is filled by tubes of lava winding down from another jagged mountainous range.  The odd mixture of elements inside of the lake has created a huge cloud of steam that hangs low in the air as the contrasting forces collide.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23292.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mammoth, twisting stalagmites mark the ground in a myriad of different sizes as if the surface was covered in toothed shards of earthen glass.  Small brown cyclones twist through the area in between the rocky pillars, lifting and depositing debris and dirt as they travel.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23293.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sky is aglow with the heat and light from a giant raging inferno that rises above the peaks of a rocky mountain range.  Ribbons of orange, red, purple, and yellow hues that stretch across the distance are reminiscent of a sunset, albeit an eerie and unnatural one.  Heavy shadows are thrown across the craggy hills and rutted ground as the fiery radiance seems to be slowly expanding.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23294.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Great pits of lava spread out over the desolate landscape like a thousand burning red eyes of a great demon.  Scorching hot vapors coil up from the fiery quarries, billowing up into the sky to create a thick opaque blanket of smoke.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23295.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A steady downpour of stinging rain soaks the fragmented dirt and casts a thick veil of mist and fog that hangs low to the ground.  Enormous boulders decorate the soaked backdrop, their forms primarily obscured by the constant deluge from above.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23296.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thunder echoes across the sky, not unlike the loud bellow of a wrathful god.  Small mounds of dirt are scattered along the ground, their jagged mouths emitting wild sprays of fire and lava, which fill the air with glowing hot embers.  Narrow bolts of blue, white, and greenish-yellow lightning dance along the horizon, releasing a surge of crackling energy with each strike.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23297.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The energy in the air is electric, with tiny bolts of white and yellow lightning dancing through the sky like the spindly legs of a thousand spiders.  The ground is a wide expanse of broken greyish-brown dirt, where tiny pebbles and stones float haphazardly above the surface.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23298.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground here is more spherical than flat, its surface littered with dozens of rugged craters.   Each earthen hollow brims with steam and iridescent reddish-orange fog.  An overpowering heat clings to the air, suffocating it while sending waves of shimmering energy across the sky.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23299.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Convulsing globules of fire and lava bleed down from the sky, bathing the area in a ruddy crimson glow while igniting the ground all around.  Thick clouds of steam roll across the blasted and uneven dirt, shrouding the area in a perpetual blanket of scorching fog.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23300.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gargantuan spires of ice-covered rock jut up from the ground and their peaks disappear among rolling patches of purplish-black clouds.  Along the edges of the immense earthen pinnacles are thousands of icy bristles, branching out like the malformed vertebrae of an ancient demon.  A deep, chilling cold clings to the air.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23301.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fire and ash mix in the crimson sky in a dark, suffocating cloud that blankets the horizon.  Slivers of fiery liquid occasionally drop down from overhead, falling like a faint shower of burning embers.  The glowing sparks throw countless tiny shadows along the ground.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23302.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The landscape is hidden beneath inches of sloshing water, sparsely broken up by earthen spikes and icy platforms that litter the surface.  The sky is an unbridled mesh of hues, ranging from dark blue to pale green as currents of energy ripple about.  Tiny flakes of snow descend from above, tossed about like glistening white feathers.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23303.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A narrow strip of land extends across a lake of gurgling lava, forming a treacherous bridge.  The low clouds glow with a sanguine hue as they reflect the molten rock.  Anvil lightning lights the clouds with bright flashes of orange before traveling straight down to strike the lake, sending lava splashing high into the air.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23304.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tornadic winds bolster fluctuating conditions, with temperatures shifting drastically from freezing to scorching in a matter of seconds.  Statically charged meteors shoot across the sky, jagged white lights trailing in their wake.  Resounding booms of unknown origin create a slow wave of ripples across the unstable ground.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23305.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ever-changing landscape ahead morphs from solid rock into a gushing torrent, the water just as suddenly evaporating into a monstrous spray of dense steam.  Fire bolts relentlessly pummel the surroundings, marring the ground with sunken craters that fling earthen debris into the wind.  Unstable columnar rotations are relentlessly dispatched from a cluster of low-hanging leaden grey clouds overhead.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23306.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pebble-sized hailstones drop from puffy azure-grey clouds in a continuous deluge.  Icy piles of bluish white hail create a shifting maze across the landscape as fluctuating temperatures melt and refreeze the hilly formations.  Intermittent gusts tear through the accumulations, snatching up bits of ice that are then deposited on nearby piles.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23307.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sizzling tongues of glowing red-orange fire unfold mid-air, feverishly licking at a half-melted wall of opaque white ice.  Deeply grooved furrows in the stony expanse drain the constant influx of water away from the glacial mass, disappearing down slivered zigzagging fractures in the terrain.  Intermittently, harsh winds rake over the land and cast the spindrift back into the ice mass with a muted whipping sound.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23308.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The earth repeatedly rolls itself into a series of mesas that rise to impressive heights before dissolving into nothing more than rubble.  Wave after wave of fiery golden flame blazes through the dry, scorched grass underfoot, the inferno ultimately dying in a raucously boiling lake with a high-pitched fizzle.  A sequence of electrical popping noises spike the air, overshadowed periodically by bouts of tempestuous thunder.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23309.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heavy and oppressive, the air is as thick as mud and nearly as suffocating.  A nearby volcanic event illuminates the area in a brilliant mixture of deep scarlet and orange, with brief flashes of intense yellow.  Unusual geometric shapes of orange-brown earth protrude from the ground, their designs carved by the divergent weather conditions.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23310.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shades of blue, indigo, and violet churn above in a vast nebula, while the pockmarked ground suffers a steady bombardment of hail.  Fierce winds gust relentlessly, driving the balls of ice into every surface with implacable force.  The air holds a frigid mist of slivers from shattered hailstones.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23311.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The endless transformation of the outlying territory is incredible to behold as land, lava, and sea materialize in and out of existence, warring with each other for superiority over the area.  One long clefted ridge of burnished obsidian remains untouched by the chaos and stretches farther than the eye can see.  Tucked below in its shadow, a barren valley runs the length of the imposing formation and is cloaked in an ethereal silver fog.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23312.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A swirling dark grey cloud churns across the open sky, its tumultuous flow producing violent shifts in air pressure.  Coin-sized balls of cloudy white hail intermittently pelt the heated earth and sizzle on impact, thin tendrils of steam rising from the ground at each landing spot.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23313.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The air is unnaturally still and crackles with intense bursts of electricity.  Luminous arcs of gold, violet, and azure traverse the sky like a bridge, wavering briefly before disappearing.  Pools of bubbling water appear along the rocky ground and then drain into the earth with a deep gurgling sound.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23314.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Grey and black clouds churn above, colliding against one another with rumbling crashes.  A network of lithic needles juts out of the ground like the teeth of a subterranean beast.  Winding among the protrusions, a jagged crack belches forth bursts of steam that rise to merge with the clouds overhead.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23315.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fog swirls about the landscape, licking at the ground's rocky surface.  Intermittent flashes of light create an illusory effect as they reflect off the thick haze.  Loud explosions reverberate from all directions, furthering the area's disorienting nature.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23316.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A striking violet backdrop emerges from behind the storm-laden dark clouds that seethe above like a roiling nimbus sea.  The intense scent of ozone pervades the air, unmoved by the sharp fluctuations in wind direction.  Expanding violently across the sky, the unwieldy haze shifts and swirls, now and then erupting with slender forks of silver-white lightning.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23317.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tiny pebbles are sucked into small cyclones and spit out as deadly projectiles, many nearby rock formations full of deep grooves as a result of constant and unrelenting pelting.  Irregular patches of ice blanket the ground, making advancement dangerous.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23318.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Towering formations of hardened molten rock dominate the horizon and canvas the ground in ominously unmoving shadows.  Steam spews from deep cracks embedded along the rocky ebon spires, releasing a silvery mist into the atmosphere with a distracting hiss.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23319.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fire and ice battle for dominance as numbing gusts battle with sweltering temperatures from opposite directions.  As the winds whip through the area, a fine layer of frost forms along the ground but succumbs to the prevailing heat, leaving scattered puddles evaporating swiftly into the atmosphere.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23320.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A full panorama of the elemental destruction is laid out below the lofty aerial point situated atop a high peak.  The devastating geological carnage is in a continual state of changeover and metamorphosis, painting a variegated portrait of the battling raw, natural forces.  To the other side, oppressive waves of rippling fire course through a hidden vale, burning away the corporeal until nothing is left but ash.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23321.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground slopes sharply downward as a constant flow of mud erodes its surface.  At the bottom of the hill, a lake of bubbling mud is blanketed by a noxious miasma.  A spire of metamorphic rock rises from its center, accusingly pointed skyward.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23322.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lining the mouth of a vast cave, raggedly formed stalagmites and stalactites lend the foreboding appearance of a feral animal baring a set of wickedly sharp teeth.  A thick, cinereous fog lurks at the base of the inlet, drifting its way toward a pocket of hole-riddled topography emiting shadowy steam from its depressions.  Tangible pressure builds in the atmosphere, unleashing rivulets of electricity that hiss and snap like an enraged serpent.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23323.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reverberating from beneath the ground like the cry of war drums, rampant vibrations cause the sod below to quake and tremble with powerful force.  Unstable as it is, the terrain is regularly pried apart to reveal gullies and ravines brimming with scalding lava or solid ice, only to reform moments later without a trace of the disturbances left behind.  In the distance, colossal amalgams of hailstone and sleet plummet from the heavens, intensely crashing into an undulating lake of copper-red fire.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23324.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The terrain is a thick quagmire of mud and crushed rock.  Bubbles rise to the surface with wet gurgles, sending malodorous vapor into the air.  Fiery jets shoot up from the depths of the muck, occasionally igniting the vapor with sickly virescent sparks.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23325.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gritty brume blankets the ground, choking the landscape with particles of dust and crushed rock.  Twisting brown cyclones dance across the horizon in paths both erratic and unpredictable, cutting fresh wounds into the already scarred land.  Dividing the terrain is a deep but narrow chasm.  Molton rock drips over its sheer walls to a flowing river of lava far below, setting the strata ablaze in hues of crimson, gold, and bronze.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23326.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A melange of roots and soil are brutally ripped from the ground by gusting vehement winds, soaking the dirt-choked air with the unusually balmy aromas of wet clay and loam.  Sloping away from the area, a deep cleft in the land yields to a broad crevasse alive with a gurgling mudflow.  Seemingly swallowing the entire environment with a deafening buzz, crackling flares of high-charged energy wail against the highland.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23327.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Protrusions of craggy rock arise from gurgling lakes of lava.  The surrounding terrain is composed of flat rock penninsulas that extend into the fiery pools, their surfaces cracked in glowing red fractals.  Overhead, billowing clouds trap the heat like a smothering blanket.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23328.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vibrations undulate through the ground, the charged pulses tearing up dirt and rock and crushing entire swathes of boulders as it travels outward in all directions.  Moments later the ground reforms, healing itself as giant stones claw back up to the surface, only to collapse again beneath each additional wave of crippling energy.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23329.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A naturally formed bridge of rock and hardened dirt stretches out over a shadowy pit with no light escaping its depths.  Thick layers of frost cover the earthen bridge, leaving behind clusters of sharp icicles and entire strips of sleet.  The air is abnormally cold.  Tiny beads of moisture intermittently freeze in the atmosphere, then fall to the ground with a tattoo of percussive pops.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23330.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dirt and stone shift chaotically here, the ground climbing and dipping like a banner flapping in a strong wind.  As the earthen ground is torn asunder, great plumes of smoke and steam briefly rise up in its wake, before once again being covered by rock and land.  A resounding thunderclap reverberates across the sky, the brief glow of yellow lightning flashing beyond toothy mountainous peaks.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23331.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Enormous columns of fire billow up from the ground in huge pillars of churning flames.  They bend and twist like fiery cyclones, their existence in a constant state of movement.  Each burning pylon grasps up at the sky, resembling colossal red fingers trying to scorch the heavens.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23332.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Frozen veins of lava weave across the ground like latticework, small threads of smoke still coiling up along their surface.  Clusters of icy crystal have formed along the edges of a circle of oval stones, motes of cerulean light fluttering about them like blue will-o'-wisps.  Heavy grey clouds swell overheard, occasionally releasing showers of fist-sized hailstones.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23333.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Murky clouds bleed across the heavens like the tattered wings of a black drake.  Their amorphous surfaces crackle with energy as bolts of iridescent lightning streak down, tearing away rock and dirt with every powerful blast.  The ground trembles and hums relentlessly like the persistent beating of a heart.
title: [Elemental Confluence]
23334.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Beneath a low ceiling of mosaic jeweled tiles, the gangway is an expansive chamber with a wood-paneled floor adorned with flourishes of red brass and brighter scarlet lacquer.  A gold-threaded rug proceeds from a portal in the eastern hull of the ship, a wide arch framed in gilded fireleaf.  Glimaerstones set in heavy, spiraled sconces cast steady light upon the ostentatious chamber.
title: [The Firebird, Gangway]
18260.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cluster of glowing glimaerstones is set into the paneled wooden ceiling, encased in a globe of rainbow glaes.  They suffuse the nexus of two hallways with multihued light that awakens many hues in the grey planking of the deck.  A painted crimson door breaches one wall, standing opposite a painting of a slumbering seaside town.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck Nexus]
24410.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A meshwork of veniom cables threads across the wooden bulkheads to either side of a sealed hatchway in the western wall.  Vivid blue-green light pulses through the frame of the hatch, accompanied by a persistent thrum that disturbs the air, like thunder without sound.  The light travels through the cabling, which bores into the body of the ship at points along the hull.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25499.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Daylight filters in through an ornate red bronze hatch in the ceiling, the ostentatious bronzework at odds with the simple, elegant care that has gone in to the stone-colored wood of the deck and paneled walls.  A spiraling stairway ascends up toward light and open sky.  Faint metallic whistling echoes down through the aperture, muted by distance so that it almost sounds like the music of woodwinds.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25504.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ornate red bronze hatch crowns the center of the upper deck, glistening from the polished greyish wood of the planking like a jewel in the sunlight.  Spiraling wooden steps proceed down into the covered main deck, their centers worn with the passage of many feet.  A ring of etched gold surrounds the hatch.
title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
25505.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ornamental red brass grate in the ceiling lets in the occasional vivid glimpse of sky.  Sunlight streaming through its apertures awakens in the grey wood of the deck sparks of color that bring a fire's heart to mind.  Along the walls, a brass-marked claret door stands opposite a wing-marked carmine hatch.  Showcased on a wooden pedestal in the hallway separating them is an ancient astrolabe made of kelyn.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25506.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cabochon soulstones dangle from braided silver chains fastened to the ceiling, bits of emerald light glinting in their milky depths.  Bathed in their glow, a single branching ebony stand holds the only wares for sale on beds of night-hued velvet.  The sounds of the ship seem dimly muted, as if coming through swaddling cloth, though no such cloth exists to excuse the diminution.
title: [Sold Souls, Salesroom]
25507.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed by hanging curtains of burgundy velvet, a wide archway marks the forward end of the main deck.  It bears a rim of red brass and gold with a stylized phoenix of red lacquer at the zenith.  Nearby, a cross-hatched burnt sienna door breaks the paneled uniformity of the hallway's starboard wall.
title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
25508.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bone fetishes dangle from the wood plank ceiling, swaying slightly and clacking together in the heavy, incense-laden air.  Held aloft by a faceless stone idol near the entrance, a shallow bowl of polished flowstone holds glittering baubles within.  Beyond the stolid guardian is a tiered rack made of widowwood.  Like the golvern-inlaid hatch behind it, its flat surfaces are carved with leaping beasts.
title: [Marks of the Beast, Showroom]
25509.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Talon-shaped marks are etched into the warm red oak of the wall panels bordering a small golvern-inlaid hatch, the only means of egress from the small workroom.  A tidy worktable sits beneath a flameless lamp of rainbow glaes at the room's center.  Its surface is strewn with an odd hodgepodge of divination tools and articles of the jeweler's craft.  Carved wooden masks hang from one wall, worked to resemble the faces of a variety of beasts.
title: [Marks of the Beast, Workroom]
25510.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sprawling bay windows curve around the airship's forward bulkhead, providing an extraordinary view of the landscape ahead.  The windows are positioned immediately beneath the ship's massive avian figurehead, and its outstretched metal talons hang within view.  On the opposite wall, a bar of flame maple and golden oak panels is stocked with an impressive variety of liquors, spirits, and wines, the bottles backlit by a row of glimaerstone orbs.  Several stools sit before it.
title: [The Firebird, Tip of the Talons]
25511.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shaded slightly by walls to either side supporting the port and starboard gangways, the upper deck is shielded from all but the strongest natural breezes, but not from the constant gusting of wind deflected by the whir of the propellers holding the ship aloft.  A towering blade assembly dominates the area, the crimson and golden lacquer adorning it vivid compared to the ash-colored wood of the deck.
title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
25512.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rising above the ship's upper deck, but not so high as the towering metal blade assemblies that propel the craft and hold it aloft, the forecastle is a swathe of space shaped like an arrowhead, tapering to a point at the bow.  The gilded and burled railing, all wrought of ash-colored fireleaf, joins with the carved bowsprit at the absolute fore of the vessel.  To the rear of the deck, broad wooden stairs proceed down toward the upper deck.
title: [The Firebird, Fo'c'sle]
25513.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Covered by an arced ceiling of transparent glaes, the sternmost portion of the upper deck is shielded from the elements.  Several chairs and tables laze underneath the faceted dome, forming a small enclave away from the bustle of the rest of the ship.  Some smooth wooden stairs form a wide path up to the smaller quarterdeck.
title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
25514.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The quarterdeck is a raised expanse toward the rear of the ship that looks out over the recessed upper deck.  Carved from smooth fireleaf and embellished with avian silhouettes, an ornate rail bearing a coat of gilt and red brass leaf surrounds the quarterdeck.  Luxuriant crimson pennants, each bearing a firebird in yellow embroidery, are strung between the propeller assemblies and the railing.  One strand of them flutters in the breeze, dipping low over some old wooden steps leading up to the aftercastle.
title: [The Firebird, Quarterdeck]
25515.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Huge bronze cannons glare brightly from embrasures in the crennelated railing surrounding the sterncastle, guarding the rear of the ship like dogs on the watch.  A wheel embellished with gold and crimson lacquer stands at the center of the deck, carved of the same greyish fireleaf as most of the deck plankings, but polished to a glassy smoothness by the touch of many hands.  The raised deck provides an unobstructed view all the way to the bow of the ship.

description: Wide and uneven, the entryway to the keep arches high above and is covered in a yellowish-white, chalky substance that exudes a foul stench.  The once firmly packed ground of the courtyard is now pockmarked with small and large holes where pieces of stone and gravel have broken free.  Directly north is the courtyard and keep tower, and an old oak drawbridge is visible past a closed and rusted out black iron portcullis.  An east-west passage traverses the wall that surrounds the Academy.
title: [Academy, Lower Bailey]
33629.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Displaying visible signs of disrepair, a lofty tower of mottled grey stone rises from the roof of the keep in the center of the open courtyard.  Breached only by a riverstone ashlar arch, the keep's tower rises far above the walls that enclose it and has far fewer missing stones in its safe.  The surrounding grounds are filled with tumbleweeds, broken tree limbs, and a variety of chipped stones, which all lie amid large tufts of greasy feathers.
title: [Academy, Lower Bailey]
33630.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Towering walls of fitted stone line this spacious hall, arcing inward near the top to form the vaulted ceiling above.  Shredded tapestries and faded wall-hangings of purple and gold hang in tattered streamers from the walls among long ribbons of dust-laden spider's webs.  Tables and chairs, splintered and unserviceable, are piled in a large heap near the arch, while a sideboard, still draped in old festival streams, leans precariously near a small passageway cut into the rear wall.
title: [Academy Keep, Great Hall]
33631.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clogged with the rotted remains of books, parchments, and scrolls, the solid monir bookcases that enclose the once great library are stained with mold and swollen with fetid water.  Broken tables and chairs lie in shambles about the space and are draped in blankets fashioned of cobwebs and dust.  Resting in the clear space at the center of the room is a polished silver tray laden with the remains of some long ago offering.
title: [Keep Tower, Library]
33632.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despite the warm golden glow of sunlight that streams in through the ashlar-framed bow window the sitting room is chilly and the air is rank with the smell of stagnant water.  Once plush chairs, now shredded and devoid of their stuffing, stand skeletal around the room in a semicircle.  Using the wall as a support, a three-legged oak sideboard draped with a moldy covering teeters under a load of rotting food.
title: [Keep Tower, Sitting Room]
33633.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several warped wooden barrels lean against the rear wall of the keep, their sides broken and their rotting contents spilling upon the uneven cobblestones of the courtyard.  Dark watermarks stain the walls around passage that has been cut into the wall of the keep tower.  The skeletal remains of a canine lie in a heap of rotted hides not far from the small entry.
title: [Academy, Upper Bailey]
33634.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Academy, Northern Wall]
33635.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The corner here is dark and damp, with much of this section of wall cracked and splitting, and the arch slightly misshapen yet still standing tall. title: [Academy, Northwest Corner]
33636.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Overgrown huckleberry bushes create a wild border around a small orchard of dead fruit trees.  Climbing strawberry vines cling to an arched opening and threaten to choke the space with their reaching tendrils.  Rotted berries, oranges, apples, and pears linger on the ground where they have fallen due to being left too long on the limb.  The scent of their soft bodies rotting upon the ground fills the air with oddly sweet, bitter perfume.
title: [Academy, Orchard Garden]
33637.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crenellated walls rise imposingly high above the unshorn lawn and create a bit of a windbreak from the gusty coastal breezes. title: [Academy, Western Wall]
33638.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flat and remarkably smooth, the grounds near the wall are littered with broken limbs, brambles, and other debris that passing storms have thrown over the wall.  Covered in a blanket of moss, the remains of a small wooden lean-to rests to one side and defiantly stands against the test of time.  Bottomless buckets, some shattered and others missing their handles, lie in a jumbled heap amid wild patches of overgrown grasses and newly sprouted brambles.
title: [Academy, Western Wall]
33639.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Filled with mortar and loose stones, a jagged scar runs down the face of the wall where a previous repair has rotted away.  Large and small bits of the upper crenellation have fallen free and clog the walking space, though it manages to still be passable.  Green stone set into an arched opening has a sheen of yellowish moisture upon it, which enhances the intricately carved staff entwined by two roses that decorates the lintel.
title: [Academy, Southwest Corner]
33640.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cloyingly sweet, the scent of roses fills the air and occupies every single space within the garden.  Thick, cord-like vines choke the swing and benches to such a degree that they actually hold them several handspans above the ground and make them impossible to utilize.  Dark petals decorate the overgrown grass within the small garden and are thickest near an arched opening.
title: [Academy, Rose Garden]
33641.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rotting piles of old hay lie in blackened heaps against the wall, their thick depths filling the air with the scents of mildew and decay.  A downed hitching post lies at the water-warped feet of several other posts, their ropes frayed and unusable.  Here and there, a stray stone has tumbled free from the wall and trampled the overgrown grasses.
title: [Academy, Southern Wall]
33642.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick blades of overgrown grass sway sporadically in the errant coastal breezes, their seed-laden heads filling the air with a wheaty scent that is a reprieve from the rot of most areas of the keep.  Faint trails, where once travelers roamed, still mark the area beneath the watchful gaze of the wall, though they are interrupted by the various stones that have tumbled free of their nesting places.
title: [Academy, Southern Wall]
33643.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cracks between each of the stones in the ashlar walls are carefully filled with a yellowish green chalky substance.  An arched opening is crowned by a single green stone which has a small carving of a man sitting on a log, his elbow resting on his knee and his chin resting on his hand.
title: [Academy, Southeast Corner]
33644.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Faded wildflowers and tufts of grass sprout from beneath a bed of pine needles carpeting the secluded garden.  In a circular hollow rests an old stone well, shaded by the overhanging branches of nearby oak and tanik trees.  Aged wooden benches near an arched opening provide weary travelers a spot to relax and meditate.
title: [Academy, Meditation Garden]
33645.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small cages with wooden slats lie stacked along the walls of the keep, each with a bit of straw lining the bottom and a small slatted door.  The ground is also covered in a light sprinkle of straw, hiding the stray pieces of grass poking their way to daylight.
title: [Academy, Eastern Wall]
33646.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Surrounded by a precariously stacked pile of broken buckets, a long wooden tub filled with fetid water nestles against the lea of the wall.  Blackened grasses provide a blanket around the structure, while yellowish tufts stand out at odd angles on the opposite side of the path.
title: [Academy, Eastern Wall]
33647.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Here, a small section of wall has shifted slightly, as if pushed up from beneath.  While still complete, it leans outward noticeably.  A large greenish stone with a carving of a bear and a tiger standing side by side sits on the peaked arch of a small opening.
title: [Academy, Northeast Corner]
33648.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clogged by overgrown topiaries, a jagged fracture in the outer wall provides egress from the academy's grounds, while an arched opening surrounded by wild bushes leads deeper inside.  Large bushes, vaguely resembling the shape of bear, monkey, tiger, and dolphin stand guardian over the grounds, their bushy heads and elongated limbs giving them a wild and crazed cast.  Lying upon the ground within a wire frame is the remains of a once regally sculpted ki-lin bush.
title: [Academy, Topiary Garden]
33649.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Leaning against the wall are various sized iron bands and stacks of thin pieces of wood.  Nearby, a low and sturdy circular block sits surrounded by small piles of wood shavings.
title: [Academy, Northern Wall]
33650.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Slabs of carved grey granite set in a spiral traverse this stairwell, wide enough to carry whole groups of people up and down the generous steps.  Small slit windows allow for a glimpse of the countryside, as slender beams of pale light barely illuminate glittering mica in the stone.  A fine layer of dust hangs over the thick iron chain that has been bolted to the walls, lending the area an unkempt appearance that is at odds with the view from the windows.
title: [Keep Tower, Stairwell]
33651.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thin shafts of light slip through the arrow loops set into the outer walls, their metallic parts missing where some previous looter has tugged them free.  All around, the ashlar walls that line the corridor display the pock-marked appearance of a surface that have been given over to dust and grim.  Slanted arches rise above a light sun-faded oak door and a dark shadowed oak door, which flank the landing.
title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
33652.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The passage looks much like the other corridors in the keep tower, the sense of strange familiarity reinforced by the identical doors and arrow loops present in the same exact locations on each level.
title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
33653.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Any sense of climbing up or down is disoriented as this corridor appears to be a perfect match to the other floors above and below.  The sliver of a view out an arrow loop is the only way to tell in which direction you might be heading.
title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
33654.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though shorter in length as the tower rises, this corridor is much the same as the others.  A small arched open window is set into the wall where the arrow loop would normally go.
title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
33655.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Light filters in from the arched opening at one end of the corridor, a surprising change from the previous levels.  The same two doors -- one hidden near the shadow of the stairs leading down, the other opposite an arrow loop -- are the only embellishment to the otherwise plain ashlar walls.
title: [Keep Tower, Corridor]
33656.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Next to an arched opening stands a wooden guard post offering an astounding view of the surrounding area.  From the top of the narrow roof on the keep tower, you can see the rolling hills to the southwest as they gradually blend into a flatter, slowly wavering countryside at the outflow of the river basin.  Glancing north, the land rises, becoming majestic mountains that stand tall and mighty, rising high into the sky.
title: [Keep Tower, Rooftop]
33657.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Chipped and scratched, a panoramic fresco surrounds the room and depicts the cliffs of Vornavis as they lead downward towards the coast.  Cobwebbed strands drop from the center of the ceiling and attach to the lifelike protrusions of the illustrations, their diaphanous ends trailing into the open spaces.  Above each of the three niches set into the walls is a small enameled crest.
title: [Keep Tower, Vornavis Room]
33658.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heavy curtains of cobwebs drape across the circular copper shield that is fitted into the worn stones of the wall, the tattered skeins dangling to dust-littered floor.  Empty sconces, blackened with the remains of burn-out torches, flank a glass and brass display case along another wall, while the remaining two display faded squares where portraits may once have been displayed.
title: [Vornavis Room, East Niche]
33659.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Faded cobalt blue paint decorates the walls, while a border of Solhaven Bay scallop shells rings the room near the dusty ceiling.  Faded pennants hang from the rafters amid brass-wrapped lanterns and a thick carpet of Vornavian silk covers the cobbled floor.  Leaning against a broken weapon stand is a glass and brass display case.
title: [Vornavis Room, West Niche]
33660.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick skeins of dust-laden webs slant across the rough stone walls of the corridor, their pallid tendrils swaying as the air beneath them is disturbed.  Tattered and faded, an ochre and pale green banner presides over a glass and brass display case.  Debris, comprised of discarded rodent bones and moldy papers, litters the floor, which is covered with a hole-riddled carpet of faded silk.
title: [Vornavis Room, North Niche]
33661.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cloudy crystals rise in shards from the cobblestone floor to form the image of a frozen witch of unsurpassed beauty.  Fragments of the the sculpture have broken free and tumbled into the dusty ground along a single line that divides the room in two distinct portions.  Affixed to the wall above the eastern niche is a small shield-shaped device, while a small tattered banner rests above the western niche.
title: [Keep Tower, Hendor Room]
33662.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Azure paint peels from the ceiling in long stripes, which are caught by the thick layers of cobwebs that cling to the corners of the room.  Splintered wood is collected in a thick pile on the northern wall opposite a blackened circle on the southern wall where someone tried to start a fire.  Pushed against the eastern wall, a glass and brass display case appears to be unscathed by the long ago blaze.
title: [Hendor Room, East Niche]
33663.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Blue and crimson enameled wings decorate the bronze body of an enormous phoenix, which is affixed to the eastern wall.  Though much of its magnificent plumage is missing, as well as the jewels that once rested in its eyes, the gaze of the fiery bird falls upon a glass and brass display case that is placed in the center of the room.  With no windows to aid in the circulation of air, the niche smells stagnant with dust.
title: [Hendor Room, West Niche]
33664.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Surrounded by washed out curtains of crushed velvet, a trio of cloudy windows of stained glass stand guard over niches recessed into the walls.  Pale outlines on the blocky stone walls have large nails in the center, evidence that artwork once was displayed there.  High over head, a cracked candelabra dangles from a frayed rope, its candles scattered and broken upon the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [Keep Tower, Aldora Room]
33665.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pure white shields, slightly greyed with dust, hang from the tops of the walls to create a decorative metallic border and provide ample purchase for spiders to build their silken nests within.  Cracked orbs dangle from rusted chains above a glass and brass display case.
title: [Aldora Room, South Niche]
33666.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fragments of broken glass litter the floor of the niche, their painted hues faded and cloudy with dust. title: [Aldora Room, East Niche]
33667.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shredded tapestries, the victim of some rodent, hang in long lengths from the walls, their once resplendent threads now dingy and mildewed. Pushed against one wall, a glass and brass display case holds court over dust bunnies and bluebird feathers.
title: [Aldora Room, West Niche]
33668.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shattered furniture, tattered tapestries, and fractured windows litter the niche with their broken and misshapen shapes. title: [Aldora Room, North Niche]
33669.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A deceptively tranquil and seductive meadow spreads out before your eyes.  You are overwhelmed for a moment by the sweet smell of the wildflowers and the constant hypnotic humming of insects.  A sink hole in a depression gushes forth with a trickling spring to one side, while along the other side of the opening, a small, mud path is evident.
title: [Meadow, Wildflower Patch]
36342.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wandering aimlessly through the pleasant meadow, you notice a few ruined markers, milestones, and a number of weed-covered mounds just to the north.  A dark, thin vertical shape and a squarer black one cleave the sky farther north.  Receding into the distance are low mountains in the northeast.
title: [Meadow, Ruins]
36343.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You weave your way through the narrow spaces between a score or so of low mounds covered with sparse vegetation.  On closer inspection, you realize they are actually ancient mass graves, hastily dug and filled.  To the south, the refreshing meadow beckons.  To the north, the dark, vertical shapes take on the terrifying aspect of some unearthly bird poised for flight.
title: [Meadow, Grave Mounds]
36344.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The mounds thin out here and the land is flat, choked with thick undergrowth.  Beneath your feet you feel large stones and debris, including arrowheads, spear tips, and shards of rusted metal.  Farther north, is another slight slope, which drops off abruptly.  From the center of the depression, rising like some phoenix not yet restored to youth, is the keep of Black Swan Castle.
title: [Meadow, Tower's View]
36345.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground here is scorched, and not even weeds have sprung up.  The nascent slope of the bank encircling the moat here is also barren, as though an unnatural blight had been visited upon it.
title: [Meadow, Scorched Ground]
36346.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The flat ground becomes barer, the weeds thin out, the castle looms closer.  The jumble of small trails converges to a track leading along the banks of the moat.
title: [Meadow, Trail]
36347.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The muck that has filtered through the grate for decades, or perhaps centuries, covers the floor of this watery hollow in the wall of the castle.  The stench is unbearable, and things which you do not particularly wish to identify splash at the surface now and then.  The ancient stone walls are covered with slime, lichens, and crawling things, and it is very hard to breathe in what little air remains.
title: [Cesspit]
36348.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gliding between the clumps of aquatic weeds choking the moat, and the inexplicable miniature maelstroms swirling around you, you utter a curse to yourself, inadvertently swallowing a large dose of the nauseating water.  You gag and redouble your efforts to traverse this obstacle.

Clumps of aquatic weeds choke this section of the moat, the hidden underwater roots forming a net for any stray appendage.  Miniature maelstroms swirl inexplicably between the weeds, indicating that there may be more beneath the surface than just roots.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Moat]
36349.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Your body is jerked like a puppet by the forceful currents of the whirlpool.  No light penetrates the murky black water, making it difficult to tell which way is up.  There is little you can do to prevent being drawn downward into the lower depths of the foul moat.
title: [Moat, Whirlpool]
36350.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Your eyes strain to find any light in the murky black water, but there is none.  The cold and pressure indicate that you are deep below the water's surface.

steps.await: and pull you down even further into the murk

title: [Moat, Underwater]
36351.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The moat floor is just within reach, if you wanted to tempt the black, eyeless creatures that scuttle along through the muck.  You can just make out the outlines of a hundred years' worth of junk that has had the misfortune of finding its way to the moat bottom.
title: [Moat, Bottom]
36352.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The decaying drawbridge suspends precariously by rusted chains that hang steadfastly frozen in place.  The strength of the old planks appears to have been sapped by the elements, attempts at forcible entry, and long neglect.  They groan ominously as the currents of the smelly moat swirl beneath you.  It is easy to see both the the shore and the castle entrance from where you stand, and face only a matter of choice of which direction you decide to go as the drawbridge creaks beneath your weight.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Drawbridge]
36353.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large, dirty heap of straw is piled against the southeast stone walls here.  Although the straw looks positively ancient, you notice fresh depressions in it, and some shallow, narrow depressions in the moist earth around the pile.  The gate in the southern wall is blocked by a raised drawbridge.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36354.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The portcullis is rusted shut, and through its barred windows you can see the now-useless drawbridge, halted in mid-course upon chains long welded solid by corrosion.  The edges of the planks comprising the portcullis and the drawbridge are charred and rot has set in.  An old watchtower stands off in a corner to the west.  At the far end of the open courtyard rises the keep, the stone pediment above the ebony doors beckoning like a mawing beak of some black bird.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36355.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Permanent gloom seems to hang in this corner of the courtyard.  The shadows of the broken and violated battlements of the fortress wall merge with those of the dark, stone tower.  Scrapes, grooves, and deep striations on the surface of the stones speak of determined enemies without clamoring to reach great treasures within.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36356.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: From this angle, the haze surrounding the keep to the northeast seems to take on the ever-cycling hues of the rainbow.  No longer merely a black, lifeless interloper against the sky, the stronghold now seems to pulsate with secret malevolent life.  Although no wind can penetrate the surrounding walls, a low, constant rustling sound can be perceived, like the beating of giant wings.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36357.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Seared grass, carbonized twigs, and trampled dirt indicate that invaders had breached the walls and mounted an assault on the east flank of the keep.  The burned-out shed here is little more than a blackened frame, with poles forming a peaked roof to which cling charred tufts of thatch.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36358.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The grand ebony doors of the Black Swan are carved in beautiful, yet somehow subtly disquieting, detail.  Impossibly shaped, the keep itself rises vertically and spreads its black wings out, casting a commanding shadow over the courtyard.  The entire facade is rife with strange architectural fillips and hideously attenuated crenelations.  It is like some evil black bird of prey, ready to take flight.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Keep]
36359.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The grand, sweeping lines of the structure that were a main feature of the exterior of Black Swan Keep continue on inside the structure.  The dark, carved walls meet to form an asymmetrical dome far above your head, where bats and pigeons have made their homes over the decades of disuse.  Large ebony doors stand at one end of the hall, and a narrow arch spans between two spindly columns that are partially hidden within the shadows.
title: [Keep, Entry Hall]
36360.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dim, dust-speckled light filters in through small airshafts along the ceiling, illuminating a path through the rubble leading away from a narrow arch between two spindly columns.  Broken furniture and mildew-covered lengths of cloth mingle with the mud and dirt on the granite floor.  The walls contain tall niches, each housing a metal cage, now ruined, that bears traces of gilt and a few semi-precious stones.
title: [Keep, Corridor]
36361.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This corridor is unremarkable and mostly featureless, save for the airshafts above and the debris on the floor.  Through the dust and muck covering the granite, you notice that the cracks between the paving stones seem wider along this section, and you feel as though the floor gives slightly beneath you with each step.  Each footfall elicits a low, creaking groan.
title: [Keep, Corridor]
36362.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A raised stone platform against one wall of the corridor holds a broken desk and a few rotting chairs.  Assorted rusting spears have been propped up in the corner, and sawhorses, chains, and iron levers anchored to the floor indicate that this was some kind of work area or guard post.  A long, deep groove bisects the ceiling above.
title: [Keep, Guardpost]
36363.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of the corridor curve sharply here, making it almost impossible to see what is around the corner.  Strange squealing sounds echo through the corridor, but turn out only to be a group of rats viciously fighting over some scrap of something foul that could be considered food.  Their little bodies swarm around back and forth, locked in combat, ignoring you completely.
title: [Keep, Corridor]
36364.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The corridor here widens into an anteroom ending in a large stone door.  The room is mostly empty save for a small table with a simple vase on top, which contains the stains of a ring of evaporated water and the sad remains of some long withered away flowers.
title: [Keep, Corridor]
36365.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This chamber is full of old junk.  There are some bent and corroded pots of all shapes and sizes lying about haphazardly.  In one corner, an old heavy basin lies broken, one side completely shattered from its impact with the floor.  Several stacks of old buckets beside a large stone door, corroded together so that it would be difficult to pull them apart.
title: [Keep, Outer Chamber]
36366.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dead carcasses of various types of vermin litter the floor here.  Rats, mice, bats, and fat spiders lie scattered everywhere, some looking freshly slaughtered.  The passageway seems as if it was once heavily guarded, betrayed by discarded weapons and armor propped against the walls or cluttering the floor.
title: [Keep, Warded Passage]
36367.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thick veneer of red lacquer covers the walls, carved in deep intaglio.  Burnished tableaux of blazing red phoenixes and haughty fighting bantams accented with cinnabar and carnelian inlay are etched into the surfaces, sectioned off by a series of ceiling-to-floor columns.  A long cedar table, beset by banks of chairs, runs down the center of the hall.  You also see a leaning cracked marble column and a frayed velvet curtain.
title: [Keep, Dining Hall]
36368.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Exposed rafters stretch out overhead, the dark wood complementing the deep indigo leather walls painted from floor to ceiling with scores of magnificent peacocks in bold strokes of iridescent blue and gilt.  Piles of worm-eaten manuscripts and books are heaped on the floor, and broken bookshelves litter the room.  A clear path runs through the rubble from a frayed velvet curtain on one wall to a barricaded door directly opposite.
title: [Keep, Study]
36369.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stone basin rests in the middle of a long, low stone table, beset by a silver pitcher and a rectangular silver tray filled with assorted hairpins.  Torn carpets, now stiff and wiry with mildew, in hues of yellow made darker by time and wear, cover the floor.   A narrow staircase leads up.
title: [Keep, Dressing Room]
36370.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stone here has been limed and whitewashed, though it is now dingy with age and soot.  Piles of white bedclothes, stained with blood and black smudges, are strewn about.  There is no sign of any furnishing, save for a large stained glass-fronted wardrobe still standing against the far wall.  A narrow staircase leads down.
title: [Keep, Sleeping Quarters]
36371.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Except for a narrow ledge, there is an abrupt drop-off here on three sides.  The walls are coated with a slight phosphor that sheds dim light.  A natural cave-in has left the ledge littered with rubble.  Some of the rubble has been cleared away, revealing a stairwell that spirals downward.  You also see a small opening.
title: [Keep, Glowing Passage]
36372.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The floor of the tower is filled with rubble and debris, leaving barely any room to squeeze through the chunks of stone and fallen timber.  Mounds of dirt and sand make it almost impossible to reach the remains of a black marble spiral stair that ascends to the lookout point above.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
36373.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This is the lookout floor of the tower.  A spiral black marble stair winds its way down in the center, while a granite platform carved into the walls allows access to the north and east doors, and the south and west windows, for watches and emergencies.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
36374.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The center of the courtyard is the sole spot where sunlight regularly manages to sneak past the guardian shadows of the towers and walls.  Weeds grow luxuriantly and tall grasses have gone to seed in what once may have been an extravagant flowerbed, nearly obscuring a spoked long-armed catapult.  Cradled in the crook of the walls, the guard tower rises up through the mists, but is overshadowed by the massive keep to the north.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36375.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sparse grass interrupts the mostly barren area just before the stone wall.  A few ruts and holes in the ground hold rainwater, forming puddles that reflect the black forms of the tower to the southwest and the keep to the northwest.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36376.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moss and black powdery lichen coat the stone wall in this northwest corner of the courtyard.  The keep of Black Swan Castle rises above you to the east, nesting upon a base of black granite and marble, with weeds growing around the foundation.  This part of the wall is also covered in vegetation, with vines working their way up, as if seeking sunlight and freedom.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Courtyard]
36377.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The shed is old and dilapidated.  Dozens of spears aged well past the point of usefulness lean up against a dented and rusted metal cabinet.  Corroded metal spheres and round boulders used for catapult ammunition have been stacked neatly in place, but are covered in a heavy layer of dust and have obviously been neglected for a long time.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Shed]
36378.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dark, curving shape of the keep obscures the view of the northwestern section of the ramparts from here, along with a good portion of the courtyard.  Just over the moat, it is possible to see an old catapult silhouetted against the mist-shrouded slopes farther east.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36379.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Here the path along the ramparts becomes very difficult, with many gaps and missing stones.  On one side of the wall there are the dour and somber forms of the tower and keep, while on the other there is the delightful contrast of a beautiful vista of fields and meadows.  The juxtaposition is striking and diverting, but the occasional crumble of stone is a sharp reminder to watch where you place your feet.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36380.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This lookout faces southeast, providing a view of the flatlands to the south and the uplands to the east.  The avian black shape of the keep looms overhead, and a tower rises like an ebony-shafted spear above the walls of the fortress.  On the ground just outside of the wall, a catapult stands watch, broken and useless.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36381.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The currents in the moat rush swiftly beneath the drawbridge to the west below.  Gazing over the other side of the wall, you see uneven patches of grass and dirt in the courtyard.  A large quantity of dirty straw is heaped at the base of the interior wall.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36382.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You stand along the top of the wall here, treading very tentatively since this spot, directly over the drawbridge and portcullis, seems to have incurred the most damage from without.  The remaining path is only a single paving stone wide in spots, and feels likely to give way under the slightest strain.  Through gaps in the wood and stones, you can see the moat swirling beneath.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36383.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tallest tower of the fortress provides the highest point for detecting enemy onslaughts.  The thin and elegant stone structure seems to stretch and crane over the landscape, like some vigilant bird poised to take flight at the first sign of attack.  Two windows, now like lifeless eye sockets, are sunk into the western and southern curves of the tower.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36384.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The natural obstacles provided by the dense forest and rocky mountains to the northeast have resulted in this lookout being in much better condition than the catapult-barraged walls to the southwest.  The umbra of the keep further darkens the charred ground and outbuilding in the courtyard below.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36385.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ramparts here are not in such an advanced state of disrepair behind the lookout tower.  The dark granite is mostly unmarred on both the inner and outer walls.  This area seems to have been spared from the full force of enemy attacks.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36386.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A green patch of grass in the middle of the courtyard looks incongruous in the midst of all the disarray and decay.  Tiny white flowers nestled in the grass can just barely be made out dotting the ground below, brightening up the area even further.  A breeze stirs the air for just a moment, bringing a bit of welcome, cool air.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36387.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Some vines have struggled their way up the ramparts here.  Their strong roots and tendrils have weakened the stone, and as you proceed, you dislodge small flakes that tumble into the moat below.  The front of the Black Swan Keep is clearly visible from here, its eerie upward sweep momentarily distracting you from your careful footing.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36388.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Looking down along the shore of the moat, you see one particularly tall, solitary tree.  It can also be noted that the corner of the keep is close, but it is not close enough for anyone to leap with any certainty of making the perilous jump.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36389.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The blank solid granite wall of the Black Swan casts a clammy chill over this part of the rampart path.  To the north, you see the dark green tops of oaks, with a smattering of pine and modwir trees.  A cold, strong updraft of air from the space between the outer wall and the back of the keep makes it difficult for you to keep your balance.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36390.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: It is a bit difficult to see your way about clearly here in the deep shadows of the keep.  Though the walls are near, it is too far for you to be able to jump across or clamber over from the ramparts to the building itself.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36391.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rear corner of the keep rises up before you.  The building is carved in upturned patterns of glistening black granite scrolls, giving it the aspect of being covered in gleaming black feathers.  Down in the alley between the keep and the wall, there is only blackness and a long drop.  The moat over the other side of the wall looks black from this vantage point as well.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36392.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The shadow of the keep's roof is cast across the rampart path.  Looking down into the courtyard, you see a burned-out hulk with a dark patch around it.  The treeline to the north goes on as far as the horizon.
title: [Black Swan Castle, Ramparts]
36393.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You are curled up into the half-circle of the cup of the catapult.  You can survey the surrounding turf nicely from here.  You also see the tip of the rope.
title: [In the Catapult]
36394.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm glow in this chamber from the many beautiful bronze sconces is almost cheerily bright.  Grand architecture is evident in the rich green tiles, giant columns, and gold leaf trim adorning the room.  The intricate richness even extends to a gleaming silver archway, a lustrous golden archway, and a sparking emerald green portal which are set equidistant from each other around the atrium.  A three-armed stone pedestal stands in the center of the chamber, boasting a yellow plate, a red plate, and a blue plate.
title: [Dungeon, Grand Chamber]
36395.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In stark contrast to the gleaming silver silver archway, this corridor has been made of large, heavy dark stone. 36402.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Dungeon, Light Room]
36403.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

36404.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

36405.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

36407.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

36414.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Dungeon, Landing]
36415.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

Dominating the southeast vista, the ruins of the Black Swan hover on the horizon.

description: The cool shade and air generated by the dense woods directly north of the path provide a disturbing counterpoint to the uneasy shadow of the high, square keep due south. title: [Field, Exterior]
36450.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

Gargoyles, scaly things, unnamed fell beasts, all squatting atop tiled, upturned roofs at weird angles.

There is no respite from the heat to be had here in the shade of the massive keep.  The building blocks any hint of a breeze, making the air almost unbearably stagnant and warm.  Clouds of gnats rise from the fetid moat, viciously attacking any living thing nearby in a frenzy of voracious hunger.
title: [Field, Exterior]
36451.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

The breeze suddenly shifts, bringing the lapping sounds and rotting water weed smell of the moat to you.  A tall, gaunt structure atop the small hummock due east diverts your attention.

title: [Field, Exterior]
